faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using Auto Crónica to suss out a car's faults before you buy.

whatIs.question: What is Auto Crónica?
whatIs.answer: It's a catalogue of chronic faults, organised by make, model, year and engine. It pulls together in one place what tends to go wrong with each car, how serious it is, at roughly what mileage it crops up and how to sort it, information that's usually scattered across forums, groups and videos.

howToSearch.question: How do I look up a car's faults?
howToSearch.answer: On the home page, fill in the make, model, year, engine and fuel type (number of doors is optional) and click "Search faults". You can also have a browse through the Defects section, which lists the most commonly reported faults by make and model.

sources.question: Where does the information come from?
sources.answer: From owners' reports and a selection of technical sources. Where there isn't enough data on a car yet, an AI flags the most likely faults, and that content is always clearly labelled as AI-generated. Over time, the community comments, corrects and votes to make it all more reliable.

mechanic.question: Does this replace a proper inspection?
mechanic.answer: No. The results are a guide to help you go into a purchase or a service better informed. Before you hand over any money, always have the car looked over by a garage you trust.

severity.question: What do the severity levels mean?
severity.answer: Each fault is rated Low, Medium, High or Critical, depending on how much it affects safety, reliability and the cost of putting it right. Where we have it, we also show the mileage at which the problem typically appears and the known fixes, step by step.

account.question: Do I need an account? Is it free?
account.answer: Searching is free and you don't need an account. Signing in with Google lets you save cars to your garage, keep track of favourites, leave comments and vote on fixes. The project is independent and kept going by donations.

garageVsFavorites.question: What's the difference between Garage and Favourites?
garageVsFavorites.answer: Your Garage is for the cars you actually own: it shows you each one's known issues at a glance. Favourites are for keeping an eye on cars you're thinking of buying or simply fancy.

contribute.question: How can I help out?
contribute.answer: Leave a comment on a fault with your own experience, photos of the repair included if you like, and vote for the fixes that worked for you. If the project has been useful, you can also chip in with a donation on the Support page.
